reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Nevada
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law require the landlord to give the tenant notice to vacate
    the property prior to terminating a tenancy?

    Sources encoded:
      - NV Rev Stat  40.251 (2021)
      - NV Rev Stat  40.2512 (2021)
      - NV Rev Stat  40.2514 (2021)
*/

% -----------------------
% Scenario facts (question)
% -----------------------

scenario_state(nevada).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Parties
scenario_landlord(landlord1).
scenario_tenant(tenant1).

% Property / tenancy facts representing the question scenario:
% We encode a common "termination of a tenancy" situation: a month-to-month dwelling unit
% subject to NRS Chapter 118A (residential).
scenario_property_kind(tenant1, dwelling_unit).
scenario_subject_to_chapter(tenant1, nrs118a).      % dwelling unit subject to NRS 118A
scenario_tenancy_type(tenant1, month_to_month).     % periodic tenancy other than week-to-week
scenario_termination_reason(tenant1, terminate_without_cause). % not nonpayment, not breach-based
scenario_tenant_status(tenant1, normal).            % not a shutdown-protected worker

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded scenario holds.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(nevada),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_landlord(landlord1),
    scenario_tenant(tenant1),
    scenario_property_kind(tenant1, dwelling_unit),
    scenario_subject_to_chapter(tenant1, nrs118a),
    scenario_tenancy_type(tenant1, month_to_month),
    scenario_termination_reason(tenant1, terminate_without_cause),
    scenario_tenant_status(tenant1, normal).

% -----------------------
% Utility classifications
% -----------------------

% tenancy_category(+TenancyType, -Category)
% Category is one of: week_to_week, periodic_other, at_will, fixed_term
tenancy_category(week_to_week, week_to_week) :- !.
tenancy_category(month_to_month, periodic_other) :- !.
tenancy_category(year_to_year, periodic_other) :- !.
tenancy_category(periodic_other, periodic_other) :- !.
tenancy_category(at_will, at_will) :- !.
tenancy_category(fixed_term, fixed_term) :- !.

% property_category(+PropertyKind, +SubjectChapter, -Category)
% Category aligns with the statute structure for notice rules.
property_category(dwelling_unit, nrs118a, dwelling_118a) :- !.
property_category(mobile_home, _Any, mobile_home_general) :- !.
property_category(mobile_home_lot, nrs118b, mobile_home_lot_118b) :- !.
property_category(recreational_vehicle_lot, _Any, rv_lot) :- !.
property_category(real_property, _Any, real_property_general) :- !.
property_category(mobile_home_lot, _Any, mobile_home_lot_other) :- !.

% -----------------------
% Statute encodings
% -----------------------

% ---- NV Rev Stat  40.251 (2021) ----
%
% Encodes when unlawful detainer is tied to continuing in possession after
% expiration of a landlord notice, implying that terminating such tenancies
% requires a notice of specified length.

% statute_40_251_notice_days(+PropertyCategory, +TenancyCategory, +Reason, -Days)
%
% For purposes of this QA, "Reason" is limited to:
%   - terminate_without_cause (end/termination of periodic tenancy)
%   - failure_to_perform_obligations_118a (special 5-day under 40.251(1)(b)(2))
%
% This predicate reflects the notice lengths in  40.251(1)(a), (b), (d).
statute_40_251_notice_days(real_property_general, week_to_week, terminate_without_cause, 7) :- !.     % 40.251(1)(a)(1)
statute_40_251_notice_days(real_property_general, periodic_other, terminate_without_cause, 30) :- !.  % 40.251(1)(a)(2)
statute_40_251_notice_days(real_property_general, at_will, terminate_without_cause, 5) :- !.          % 40.251(1)(a)(3)

statute_40_251_notice_days(dwelling_118a, week_to_week, terminate_without_cause, 7) :- !.             % 40.251(1)(b)(1)(I)
statute_40_251_notice_days(dwelling_118a, periodic_other, terminate_without_cause, 30) :- !.          % 40.251(1)(b)(1)(II)
statute_40_251_notice_days(dwelling_118a, _AnyTenancy, failure_to_perform_obligations_118a, 5) :- !.  % 40.251(1)(b)(2)

statute_40_251_notice_days(rv_lot, _AnyTenancy, terminate_without_cause, 5) :- !.                     % 40.251(1)(d) "at least 5 days"

% Note: 40.251(1)(c) (mobile home lots subject to 118B) depends on other notice
% statutes (NRS 118B.115, 118B.170, 118B.190). We encode the existence of a notice
% requirement but do not compute days without those cross-referenced texts.
statute_40_251_notice_required_but_days_unspecified(mobile_home_lot_118b, terminate_without_cause) :- !. % 40.251(1)(c)

% ---- NV Rev Stat  40.2512 (2021) ----
%
% Nonpayment of rent requires a written pay-or-quit notice with time periods.
% Contains exception for shutdown-protected workers.

% statute_40_2512_notice_days(+PropertyCategory, +TenantStatus, -Days)
statute_40_2512_notice_days(_PropertyCategory, shutdown_protected_worker, not_applicable) :- !. % 40.2512(2)
statute_40_2512_notice_days(commercial_premises, _TenantStatus, 5) :- !.                        % 40.2512(1)(a)
statute_40_2512_notice_days(real_property_general, _TenantStatus, 7) :- !.                      % 40.2512(1)(b) seven judicial days
statute_40_2512_notice_days(dwelling_118a, _TenantStatus, 7) :- !.                              % treated as "real property other than commercial"
statute_40_2512_notice_days(mobile_home_lot_other, _TenantStatus, 10) :- !.                     % 40.2512(1)(c)
statute_40_2512_notice_days(mobile_home_lot_118b, _TenantStatus, 10) :- !.                      % 40.2512(1)(c)

% ---- NV Rev Stat  40.2514 (2021) ----
%
% Certain lease violations / nuisance / unlawful business / waste / certain drug-law
% violations require 3 days' notice to surrender.

% statute_40_2514_notice_days(+Reason, -Days)
statute_40_2514_notice_days(assignment_or_sublet_contrary_to_lease, 3) :- !.  % 40.2514(1) + 3 days notice
statute_40_2514_notice_days(waste, 3) :- !.                                  % 40.2514(2)
statute_40_2514_notice_days(unlawful_business, 3) :- !.                       % 40.2514(3)
statute_40_2514_notice_days(nuisance, 3) :- !.                                % 40.2514(4)
statute_40_2514_notice_days(drug_law_violation, 3) :- !.                      % 40.2514(5)

% -----------------------
% Legal reasoning helpers
% -----------------------

% required_notice_to_vacate(+Tenant, -Days)
% Computes whether Nevada law (2021) requires a notice to vacate for the scenario's termination,
% and if so provides Days. If Days is 'unspecified' it still counts as a notice requirement.
required_notice_to_vacate(Tenant, Days) :-
    scenario_state(nevada),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_property_kind(Tenant, PropertyKind),
    scenario_subject_to_chapter(Tenant, SubjectChapter),
    property_category(PropertyKind, SubjectChapter, PropertyCategory),
    scenario_tenancy_type(Tenant, TenancyType),
    tenancy_category(TenancyType, TenancyCategory),
    scenario_termination_reason(Tenant, Reason),
    scenario_tenant_status(Tenant, TenantStatus),
    required_notice_to_vacate_by_statutes(PropertyCategory, TenancyCategory, Reason, TenantStatus, Days).

% required_notice_to_vacate_by_statutes(+PropertyCategory, +TenancyCategory, +Reason, +TenantStatus, -Days)
% Deterministic selection among statutes.
required_notice_to_vacate_by_statutes(_PropertyCategory, _TenancyCategory, nonpayment_of_rent, TenantStatus, Days) :-
    % 40.2512 governs nonpayment (unless shutdown exception makes it not applicable)
    !,
    statute_40_2512_notice_days(real_property_general, TenantStatus, Days0),
    ( Days0 = not_applicable -> fail
    ; Days = Days0
    ).
required_notice_to_vacate_by_statutes(_PropertyCategory, _TenancyCategory, Reason, _TenantStatus, Days) :-
    % 40.2514 specific breaches -> 3-day notice
    statute_40_2514_notice_days(Reason, Days),
    !.
required_notice_to_vacate_by_statutes(PropertyCategory, TenancyCategory, Reason, _TenantStatus, Days) :-
    % 40.251 general termination/holdover notice scheme
    statute_40_251_notice_days(PropertyCategory, TenancyCategory, Reason, Days),
    !.
required_notice_to_vacate_by_statutes(PropertyCategory, _TenancyCategory, Reason, _TenantStatus, unspecified) :-
    % 40.251(1)(c) requires notice but days are in cross-referenced statutes not provided here
    statute_40_251_notice_required_but_days_unspecified(PropertyCategory, Reason),
    !.

% law_requires_notice_to_vacate_in_scenario(-yes_or_no)
law_requires_notice_to_vacate_in_scenario(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    required_notice_to_vacate(tenant1, _Days),
    !.
law_requires_notice_to_vacate_in_scenario(no) :-
    !.

% -----------------------
% Final answer predicate
% -----------------------

housing_answer(Result) :-
    law_requires_notice_to_vacate_in_scenario(Result),
    !.

% -----------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require the landlord to give the tenant notice to vacate the property prior to terminating a tenancy?
